description: A 96-metre travertine and glass office tower completed in 2015, designed by Pei Cobb Freed & Partners. The model preserves its rectangular lattice, taller top glazing and recessed double-height lobby. Low LOD groups typical floor rows; High LOD retains all 17. Dimensions beyond the published height and lobby are estimates. Visual study uses nine user-provided photos whose licenses are unverified; photos are not included. Publication provenance review remains outstanding.
